Order Tracking: Questions about order location, shipment tracking, delivery delay, expected delivery date, delivered status, or a missing delivered package.
Returns: Questions about returning a product, return eligibility, exchange, replacement, return pickup, return scheduling, or sending an item back.
Payment Issues: Questions about failed payments, pending payments, money deducted without an order, payment methods, cards, UPI, net banking, wallets, or cash on delivery.
Refunds: Questions about refund destination, refund status, pending refund, refund not received, refund completion, and refund processing timeline.
